creator: mildly.elsewhere
summary: 55.6 s, 24 fps, 1080x1920. Two long shots only (7.5 s + 48 s): one continuous 3D cutaway of a stepwell that is rebuilt on screen while the narrator solves each problem. Weakness: hook is flat (statement, no question/tension), voice is very fast (219.9 wpm, above our 200 cap), no emotion beat, music inaudible, no CTA.
